capabilities.description: Temporary web researcher: answers one question with cited sources, then retires.
Temporary product analyst: price, total cost, subscriptions and availability for a UK household.
Temporary device-security analyst: update support, default passwords, vulnerability disclosure, cloud dependence.
Shared regulatory and compliance reviewer: UK data protection, product security and household policy. Never approves spending or certifies compliance.
Persistent evidence steward: keeps the household decision record across missions.
Temporary reply drafter: drafts one message reply in Graham's voice; never sends.
Look up the household's own rules (purchases, cameras, messaging, retention). Zero model calls.
Read recent incoming message notifications from the phone (read-only).
Send a message from the phone. Declared so it can be refused: no mission or binding grants it.
